verdict.rationale: Openness of source code is a fair question for an AI video model, since open-weight and open-source video models exist. Nothing in the pack shows Veo's source or weights released under an open license. Veo is presented only as a hosted Google model, reached through Gemini, Flow and the Gemini API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
